title: SpearControl
description: Ever wanted to control spear functionality?
body:
# This plugin requires ProtocolLib

# SpearControl
**Control spear functionality on your server. This plugin gives administrators granular control over spear mechanics without removing the items entirely.**

### Features
- Block spear crafting with permissions
- Block spear usage with permissions
- Remove lunge enchantments from players
- Block netherite spear upgrades
- Real-time enforcement when players switch items
  
### Commands
- /spearcontrol reload - Reload config
- /spearcontrol status - Show settings
  
### Permissions
- spearcontrol.use - Use spears
- spearcontrol.craft - Craft spears
- spearcontrol.lunge - Keep lunge enchantments
- spearcontrol.upgrade - Upgrade to netherite
- spearcontrol.admin - Admin commands

### Configuration
Edit config.yml to enable/disable features and set permission requirements. Each feature can be toggled independently.

### Requirements
- Java 21
- PaperMC 1.21.x
- ProtocolLib
